_meta: Per-leader voice mapping for DowagerMod Chatter voiceover. v2: thick locale-only voices preferred over Multilingual variants. Each leader gets the THICKEST authentically-accented voice for the locale closest to their actual cultural/linguistic background. The Multilingual voices (e.g. de-DE-FlorianMultilingual) sound smoother / more international; the locale-only ones (e.g. de-DE-Conrad) sound like that nationality is GENUINELY trying to speak English. We want the second flavor — that's the comedy AND the historical realism. All 59 voices below are unique. Lookup is case-insensitive on alphanumeric chars only ('Mansa Musa' -> 'mansamusa').

_realism_notes.Alexander: mk-MK voice literally named 'Aleksandar' — Macedonian is the modern descendant of Alexander's homeland
_realism_notes.Catherine the Great: de-DE thick German — she was born German, ruled Russia, and historians note she NEVER lost her German accent at the Russian court
_realism_notes.Hannibal: ar-TN Tunisian Arabic — Carthage was in modern Tunisia. As historically accurate as it gets for a 2200-year-old leader
_realism_notes.Genghis Khan: kk-KZ Kazakh — Azure has no Mongolian neural voice; Kazakh is the closest living Turkic-Mongolic relative
_realism_notes.Suryavarman: km-KH Khmer — he WAS Khmer, ruling the Khmer empire that built Angkor Wat
_realism_notes.Ragnar Lothbrok: is-IS Icelandic — Icelandic is the closest living language to Old Norse; Vikings would basically sound like this
_realism_notes.Stalin: uk-UA Ukrainian — Stalin was Georgian-born but Azure has no Georgian voice. Ukrainian gets closest to Slavic Soviet feel without sharing Peter the Great's Russian voice
_realism_notes.Saladin: ar-SA Saudi Arabic — Saladin ruled Egypt + Syria + Arabian peninsula; Saudi Arabic represents the Arab heartland of his empire
_realism_notes.Napoleon: fr-FR-Yves thick French male — Napoleon famously had a thick Corsican-French accent his whole life. The Yves voice has a slightly older/coarser tone than the courtly Alain (Louis XIV)
_realism_notes.Catherine NOT French anymore: Previous version gave her French (she spoke French at court), but Yves Henri Catherine all spoke fr-FR. de-DE-Katja captures the actual accent she would have had speaking English
_realism_notes.Pacal II: es-MX-Liberto Mexican Spanish — Mayan civilization was in modern southern Mexico/Guatemala
_realism_notes.Huayna Capac: es-PE Peruvian Spanish — the Inca empire was Peru-centered; closest living regional Spanish accent
_realism_notes.Frederick the Great: de-DE-Christoph thick German — austere, disciplined Prussian
_realism_notes.Justinian: it-IT-Gianni — Byzantine emperor whose legal code was in Latin; Italian gives him the imperial-Roman gravitas with a Mediterranean accent
_realism_notes.Reginald Endicott Barclay: en-GB-Elliot — Star Trek nervous nerd. Pure inside-joke pick for the modder Easter egg leader.
